text:
June 17, 1970
Selection of site developers completed.
July 9, 1970
Request for Proposal No. H-4-71 issued, calling for proposals for quality control consultant.
February-September, 1970
Site planners developing conceptual site plans, detailed site designs.
July 20, 1970
39 proposals received in response to RFP H-4-71.
June-September, 1970
Contracts negotiated with eight site developers. Two sites dropped from program.
June-December, 1970
Housing systems proceeding wih Phase I, Design and Development activities.
December, 1970
Site acquisitions completed, ground broken on all sites.
January, 1971
Active construction started at Kalamazoo, Macon, Sacramento sites.
March, 1971
First housing arrives at Kalamazoo site.
January-December, 1971
Construction activity started on all sites, continuing on all sites.
March, 1972
First families occupy units at Kalamazoo, Memphis, and St. Louis sites.
December, 1972
Projected completion and sale of all sites except Jersey City, which is projected for completion in spring of 1973.
